title: Hair and cloth physics
player_outcome: Hair, capes, robes and banners move: hair sways with movement and wind, capes/robes flutter, NPC clothes react to walking.
design: Lightweight bone-chain springs (verlet) on hair/cape/robe bones exported by the human generator (tools/blender human rig gets a few dangle bones), simulated in game code with LOD (near only), wind from strata_wind; budgeted per preset.
Quality bar: what a AAA, realistic 3D Terraria made by Re-Logic would ship. Data-driven, performance-budgeted by graphics preset, Core logic tested, follows docs/overhaul/_BRIEF.md (LEAN MODE).
verification: animation tour shows hair sway (one short shot)
